subject: Scaling concession approval + operational onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@orbitix.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Luke Chen <luke@orbitix.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming renewal — need short price stability & onboarding support

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks again for the Q1 QBR — Orbitix is excited to expand usage into two new product teams starting June. Before we spin up heavy consumption, procurement asked if Redwood can do two things for the renewal amendment: a) a 3-month price stability (no increases) on our committed rates and b) a one-time onboarding credit to cover integrator hours and playbooks.

To give you context: our usage is projected to rise ~40% month-over-month for three months as we migrate two teams. The stay-on-rate helps our CFO sign off; the onboarding credit covers the SOW with our integration partner. We've attached the latest term sheet and our Q1 usage extract.

High-level asks:
- 3-month price stability at current effective rate (no step-ups for May–Jul)
- One-time credit: $25k applied to first invoice after go-live
- Minor change to commit (shift 20% of long-tail commit to a short-term uplift tranche)

Can you confirm feasibility and any approvals needed from your side? We'd like to lock this this week to align legal and our procurement calendar.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call.

—Sarah
Sarah Wong
VP Engineering, Orbitix

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@orbitix.ai>, Luke Chen <luke@orbitix.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — need short price stability & onboarding support

Ben / Lauren — looping you in.

Summary of Orbitix asks: 3-month price stability on current effective rate, $25k onboarding credit, and a short-term commit reshuffle (move ~20% into an uplift tranche). They need a quick answer to keep procurement on schedule.

Initial commercial read: doable but we should:
- Offer a time-limited price stability addendum (May 1–Jul 31) at current effective rate rather than an ongoing discount; that limits runway risk.
- Convert the $25k onboarding credit into a one-time invoice credit tied to onboarding milestones (kickoff + integration signoff).
- Model the commit move as a temporary uplift (6-month tranche) that reverts to baseline at term end — this avoids changing long-term committed ARR.

Action items for approval:
- Ben: can you run a quick ARR/cost delta for the 3-month hold + $25k credit and flag materiality? If <$50k NPV impact, I'll greenlight commercial.
- Lauren: legal/ops — can you draft a 1-page amendment (price stability addendum + milestone credit language) we can send to Orbitix? Keep DocuSign friendly.

Sarah / Luke — we can likely approve this internally if impact is modest. Ben will follow with numbers today. Lauren will give timing for a draft.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Hannah / Lauren — ran the numbers. Key points:

Commercial impact (rough):
- 3-month price stability (no increases) on the incremental uplift results in ~ $34k revenue deferral vs. our conservative forecast (NPV impact ~ $27k).
- One-time $25k credit = direct reduction on first invoice.
- Net-of-credit, expected 6-month lift will generate incremental usage that offsets the short-term hold; long-term ARR unchanged if uplift sustains.

Recommendation:
1) Approve the 3-month price stability addendum (May 1–Jul 31) at current effective rates.
2) Grant the $25k onboarding credit, applied to the invoice post-kickoff, conditional on integration milestone acceptance (standard ops checklist).
3) Model the commit change as a temporary tranche labeled "Uplift Reserve" that auto-reverts at term end (no contract reprice).

Operational asks for Orbitix onboarding:
- Assign a single technical owner for the Redwood integration (name + email).
- Provide SOC2 enclave details for the two teams before provisioning.
- Weekly 30-min sync for first 6 weeks (ops + customer success).

If leadership signs off, I'll mark the P&L impact as below our internal threshold and Lauren can prepare the amendment.

(attachment: orbitix_pricing_impact_summary.xlsx)

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Please send the 1-page amendment and a DocuSign link; Luke will be our contracting lead. Can we have the amendment by EOD Wednesday so procurement can loop legal and finalize?

Looking forward — we'll schedule the ops kickoff for the first week of May.

Best,
